name: Return the single most-recent wizard session for a workflow (and optional skill), or 204 if none exists
description: Return the single most-recent wizard session for a workflow (and optional skill), or 204 if none exists Return the single most-recent wizard session for a workflow (and optional skill), or 204 if none exists. GET /api/projects/{project_id}/wizard/sessions/latest/
context:
GET /api/projects/{project_id}/wizard/sessions/latest/
Return the single most-recent wizard session for a workflow (and optional skill), or 204 if none exists. Unlike `list`, this is a point lookup the app shell uses to decide whether to open the live SSE stream — it never returns a collection, and 'no run' is a 204 rather than a 404 so clients don't conflate it with a missing endpoint.
Required: project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.; workflow_id (query) — Workflow to inspect.
Optional: skill_id (query) — Optional skill within the workflow.

name: Server-Sent Events stream of wizard session updates for a (workflow_id, skill_id) pair
description: Server-Sent Events stream of wizard session updates for a (workflow_id, skill_id) pair Server-Sent Events stream of wizard session updates for a (workflow_id, skill_id) pair. GET /api/projects/{project_id}/wizard/sessions/stream/
context:
GET /api/projects/{project_id}/wizard/sessions/stream/
Server-Sent Events stream of wizard session updates for a (workflow_id, skill_id) pair. On connect, the current latest session (if any) is emitted as the first event; subsequent upserts are streamed in real time. The server closes the connection after 900 seconds with an `event: end` line so the client (EventSource) can reconnect. **SDK consumers**: do not call the generated fetch wrapper for this path — it will buffer the entire infinite stream. Use the URL builder (`getWizardSessionsStreamRetrieveUrl`) with the browser's `EventSource` API instead.
Required: project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.; workflow_id (query) — Workflow to inspect.
Optional: skill_id (query) — Optional skill within the workflow.
